budget_policy: Reuse continuous_research_shared_v1 API reservations and original 128 candidate starts/day; no new account, reset, refund or per-space allowance.
alpha_policy: Original lifetime 0.05/[t*(t+1)], inherited 1444 plus every reserved unique candidate including invalid results; no space/day reset.
initial_space: Exactly the existing K grid, including all legacy global dedup records and outstanding requests, proposals and batches.
successor_algorithm: LOCAL_RESULT_REFINEMENT, not AI authored: rank completed valid training AND validation views by validation log growth descending, drawdown ascending, candidate id ascending. Choose first parent with globally unseen configurations in the Cartesian center/adjacent-one-step grid of the three refinement axes. Keep its other axes fixed. Maximum 27 configurations before global dedup; use original rule. No performance PASS threshold. If frontier is empty, report IDLE_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOVEL_FRONTIER.
eligibility: Both exact original training and validation intervals, cutoff <= 2021-12-17, finite numeric log_growth and mdd, valid receipts. Read only training_view; diagnostics/statistics never enter selection. Invalid or unavailable feedback cannot seed a successor.
transition: Only after all current configurations registered globally, no open batch, no unassigned proposal, no unresolved scientific attempt and no pending AI request. Pending old response is WAIT_PENDING_SPACE_REQUEST, not exhaustion. Freeze successor before accepting or evaluating its members.
freeze: Append-only research_spaces, space_batches, space_ends tables; parent hash, bounded parent evidence, full safe feedback digest/count, contract/code binding, enum schema, novel count, windows, frequency policy, contamination, lifetime alpha design before results. Batch-to-space link exists before backtest. Resume reuses frozen space and reservations.
dedup: Canonical genes and rule+genes identities exclude space id, text and lineage. All legacy and new hashes retained globally. Parameter refinement is a new configuration, not a new market discovery.
ai: Existing metered broker continues with compact frozen successor enum schema and space id/hash in request. No entire history or growing hash list; exact parser limits unchanged. Old requests retain their original wire bytes.
overfitting: All history remains seen development; repeated validation selection and diagnostic inspection are contamination. Conditional p-values and unverified independence never confirm a trading candidate. Original cutoffs, sealed interval, statistical thresholds, data identity/LUNA invalidation and cost/exit math unchanged.
finite_authority: No expansion outside declared envelope, no new lookback values, family, data, executable AI code or trading authority. Empty eligible novel frontier means IDLE, not recycling. A later wider envelope requires another versioned authorization.
